{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders: only use completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of channels and segments in completed orders
print("Channel distribution (completed only):")
print(completed_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution (completed only):")
print(completed_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment in completed orders
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment (completed only):")
print(pd.crosstab(completed_df['channel'], completed_df['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment, but only on completed orders
# Note: `converted` is already 1 for completed orders, so we can use it directly
conversion_by_channel_segment = completed_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment (completed only):")
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Compute raw conversion rate by channel (completed only)
raw_conversion_by_channel = completed_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nRaw conversion rate by channel (completed only):")
print(raw_conversion_by_channel)

# Compute segment counts (completed only)
segment_counts = completed_df.groupby('customer_segment').size().reset_index(name='count')
print("\nSegment counts (completed only):")
print(segment_counts)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
segment_diffs = []
for segment in completed_df['customer_segment'].unique():
    subset = completed_df[completed_df['customer_segment'] == segment]
    email_conv = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    paid_conv = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = email_conv - paid_conv
    segment_diffs.append({'segment': segment, 'diff': diff, 'email_conv': email_conv, 'paid_conv': paid_conv})

segment_diffs_df = pd.DataFrame(segment_diffs)
print("\nDifference in conversion rates by segment (completed only):")
print(segment_diffs_df)

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel (completed only)
weighted_email_conv = 0.0
weighted_paid_conv = 0.0
for segment in completed_df['customer_segment'].unique():
    seg_count = segment_counts[segment_counts['customer_segment'] == segment]['count'].values[0]
    total_count = segment_counts['count'].sum()
    weight = seg_count / total_count
    
    email_conv = completed_df[(completed_df['channel'] == 'email') & (completed_df['customer_segment'] == segment)]['converted'].mean()
    paid_conv = completed_df[(completed_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (completed_df['customer_segment'] == segment)]['converted'].mean()
    
    weighted_email_conv += weight * email_conv
    weighted_paid_conv += weight * paid_conv

overall_diff = weighted_email_conv - weighted_paid_conv

print(f"\nAdjusted conversion rate difference (email - paid_search): {overall_diff}")

# Compute raw difference for comparison
raw_diff = raw_conversion_by_channel[raw_conversion_by_channel['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].values[0] - \
           raw_conversion_by_channel[raw_conversion_by_channel['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].values[0]

print(f"\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff}")

# Return the adjusted difference
overall_diff"}
